heygen.motion_prompt: Talks to the camera like a friendly, upbeat podcast host who enjoys the topic. Smiles often: a warm smile at the start and end of each sentence and a bigger smile on good news. Natural head turns and small nods on key points, an occasional small hand gesture that returns to rest, eyes on the camera.

lines: This video is AI-generated from my own script.

prompts.walk_in: A plain empty room. A man walks into the frame from the right side with a relaxed, natural stride, stops in the center facing the camera, smiles warmly and gives a small friendly nod. He is exactly the man in the final frame: same face, glasses, beard and clothes. Steady locked-off camera, realistic motion.
prompts.walk_up: The man in the photo walks toward the camera with a relaxed, natural stride, stops close to the lens, smiles warmly and gives a small friendly nod. His face and clothes stay the same. Steady locked-off camera, realistic motion.

kling.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, extra limbs, warped face, changing clothes, text, watermark
